BbeTools là bộ công cụ tiện ích miễn phí: BbeTools is a collection of free utility tools that run entirely in your browser. It started in Vietnamese and is now available in English too.
File của bạn không rời khỏi máy: Your files never leave your device
BbeTools không có máy chủ xử lý. Khi bạn: BbeTools has no processing server. When you merge PDFs, compress images or make ID photos, every calculation runs in JavaScript and WebAssembly right in your browser tab. Files, text, camera images and microphone audio aren't sent anywhere. You can even go offline once the page and libraries have loaded, and the tools keep working.
Trang tải những gì từ Internet?: What does the site load from the Internet?
The website itself, from GitHub Pages.
Font chữ và thư viện mã nguồn mở (pdf-li: Fonts and open-source libraries (pdf-lib, pdf.js, JSZip, image encoders, HEIC decoder, QR reader…) from the jsDelivr CDN, pinned to exact versions. Heavy libraries only load when you open a tool that needs them. The CDN only sees the library requests, never your files.
Mô hình AI tách nền (cho Làm ảnh thẻ) đặ: The background-removal AI models (for ID photos) are hosted on this website itself.
Riêng công cụ Tải sticker Telegram: trìn: The Telegram Sticker Downloader is the one exception: your browser talks directly to Telegram's servers (api.telegram.org) with your own bot token to fetch the sticker set. BbeTools has no server in between and never receives the token.
BbeTools dùng Google Analytics để đếm lư: BbeTools uses Google Analytics to count page views (which pages are used most, where visitors come from, phone or computer), so we know which tools to improve. Google Analytics only receives the page address; file names, file contents, text and numbers you enter into tools are never sent. You can block it with an ad blocker or the Google Analytics opt-out add-on; every tool keeps working.
Không có quảng cáo, không có cookie quản: No ads, no advertising cookies. “Recently used”, “Favorites” and settings are only stored in your own browser storage (localStorage); clearing site data removes them.

Calculation results are for reference only; data with legal implications shows its update date on each page.
